definitions.explanation: The work or type of work that someone does as their regular employment.

examples.notes: Formal way to ask about someone's job

examples.japanese: {職業|しょくぎょう}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Freedom of occupational choice is guaranteed by the constitution.

examples.japanese: {職業|しょくぎょう}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦スキル→スキル：08815_sukiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につけた→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I acquired new skills through vocational training.

notes:
{職業|しょくぎょう} is more formal than ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {職業|しょくぎょう}: formal, used on forms and in official contexts
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: general/neutral, everyday use
- ⟦お{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: polite, conversational

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職業|しょくぎょう}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧ (vocational training)
- {職業|しょくぎょう}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧ (job placement)
- {職業|しょくぎょう}⟦{病|びょう}→病：noentry⟧ (occupational disease)
- {職業|しょくぎょう}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ (professional awareness)
